name: agent-directory-card
title: Agent Directory Card
description: One agent in the directory: its name the card's one link, status and verified mark, where it lives, its job, example asks, apps, maintainers and Chat; a grid card or a list row.

meta.whenToUse: Listing agents people can use: the agents directory, a templates list.
meta.whenNotToUse: A person or space directory (the app's DirectoryCard), or an agent's own page header (RecordHeader).
